answer.label: fine-tune bias
answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements were available. The raw-score shift ÷ TV is 11.5 ×10⁵, which matches fine-tune bias (10.4 ± 0.4) and is far from every other class (2.3–3.9). The other logit values agree with fine-tune bias: top-1 agreement 0.938 (vs 0.935), sequence agreement 0.562 (vs 0.583), KL 0.071 (vs 0.082), TV 0.076 (vs 0.082) and Token-DiFR gap 0.226 (vs 0.219). Quantization is the nearest alternative on KL and top-1 agreement, but its raw-score shift (2.3) and DiFR gap (0.038) are far off. Fine-tune backdoor has a higher KL (0.15) and a raw-score shift of only 3.3. The system-prompt classes have KL above 0.2. None is ruled out by the non-zero values.
